title: Explorer notice
responsibility: Shows a side note that qualifies what a screen shows, such as a reading that may be incomplete.

inputs.name: Notice.as
inputs.description: Optional semantic paragraph, block or list element. Defaults to p; ul keeps a list when role is list.

inputs.name: Notice.className
inputs.description: Optional existing owner classes. Defaults to ex-notice.

inputs.name: Notice.role
inputs.description: Optional semantic role. Defaults to note; list preserves the native list treatment when as is ul.

inputs.name: Notice.id
inputs.description: Optional native id. Defaults to JavaScript undefined.

inputs.name: Notice.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting aria-label.

inputs.name: Notice.component
inputs.description: Optional owner attribution. Defaults to JavaScript undefined.

inputs.name: Notice.children
inputs.description: Required caller content. Rendering errors propagate without replacing or suppressing its values.

outputs.name: Notice
outputs.description: Semantic Notice markup retaining caller content, native accessibility and the selected existing treatment.

errors.name: Content rendering error
errors.description: Errors from the required content snippet propagate to the owner.
